title: Bunker Reimaged
description: This plugin allows you to play the board game Bunker in Minecraft.
body:
This plugin allows you to play the board game Bunker in Minecraft.

/adminbook to get the admin panel to start the game

The plugin supports 4 languages: English, Ukrainian, Halychian, and Russian.

Easy control via GUI

![Admin gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb6ed2ef99e8e79ae0ce59557b4bba49874ed8fd.jpeg)

![Player gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6578743ac61e21db8aecd7428e5158b8799f81d.jpeg)

![card example ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b2a4493414d4988eb49b5655a1ca235088dda22.jpeg)

also, all cards and translations can be replaced via a text file in plugin folder 

A map for this plugin will be created later.
